en: [TAB]Where the Order values law, the Empyrean values wisdom. Adjudication started from the teachings of Lugus and punishment is not based on adherence to a labyrinthine codex of laws, but from direct consultation on the merits of each case. Social equality and impartiality are the model between a government and its citizens as well as between empires. As such the Empyrean gives equal voice to small empires as it does those that dominate Erebus. [PARAGRAPH:2]State Religion allows access to:[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Radiant Guard (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Ratha (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Vicar (unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB]Chalid Astrakein (world unit)[PARAGRAPH:1][TAB][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITADEL_OF_LIGHT]Citadel of Light[\\LINK] (improvement)[PARAGRAPH:2]The Empyrean has major conflicts with both The Ashen Veil and the Council of Esus. One may prevent the spread of another into a city, or drive the other out. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Empyrean was the driving force behind the founding of the Overcouncil. No player may adopt the Overcouncil civic until this religion is founded. [PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\\LINK], the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_LAERAN_CORD]The Laeran Cord[\\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Good lands and weakened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_SUN]Sun Mana[\\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SPIRE_OF_THE_SUN]Spire of the Sun[\\LINK], a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITADEL_OF_LIGHT]Citadel of Light[\\LINK], a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOWER]Tower[\\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\\LINK], or [LINK=TERRAIN_DESERT]Desert[\\LINK] terrain. It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_SHADOW]Shadow Mana[\\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]Whispering Wood[\\LINK], or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WODES_OAK]Wode's Oak[\\LINK]. \r\n\r\n

[TAB]The power beneath the Aegean waves is said to be more powerful than any other, but the Undertow are unfocused and follow a thousand different obscure agendas. The Disciples of the Undertow dare not expose themselves directly to the conflicting commands of their masters and instead use the poor as intermediaries. They are quickly driven insane by the process, which the disciples prefer as it keeps them from manipulating the message. They also share the process of turning a warrior into The Drown, undead thralls, a process with few volunteers. The church of Camulos wants war between all nations. He is known as the Sanguine Fountain and the Hundred Armed God. On the nights before large battles, the skies echo with the shrill cries of Camulos's demons, peering out expectantly for the coming war. In cities that don't outlaw them, temples to Camulos are brutal arenas where corpses of the freshly killed lie in piles, feral animals feast on the bodies, and nearly every stone is blood stained. This is a religion based on hate. It is racist in some countries, anti-cultural group in others. The target doesn't matter to the religion, only the hate that is fueled by it. 
		
		
		
[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Demons of [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\LINK], Undertow, [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]The White Hand[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\LINK]. It will be weakened in Good or neutral lands and strengthened in Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_CHAOS]Chaos Mana[\LINK] and weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_LAW]Law Mana[\LINK]. It is strenthened on Wastelands, Fields of Perdition, [LINK=FEATURE_BLIZZARD]Blizzards[\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_TORMENTED_SOULS]Tormented Souls[\LINK], and weakened on [LINK=FEATURE_HALLOWED_GROUND]Hallowed Ground[\LINK].
